caption:
Stock market news | Trusted Person Approval and Stop Switch proposed by RBI

The Reserve Bank of India announced proposals that would require a trusted person's approval for large digital transfers, introduce an emergency stop switch to block suspicious activity, and change bank liability rules for fraud cases.
These measures aim to protect customers, reduce fraud losses and strengthen confidence in online banking and payments.
